Fees: $15 non-refundable application, $185 recreation fee. Normal high-use Yampa trip 5 days/4 nights (NPS 2025 guide).

A day float from West Cross Mountain that takes out at Deerlodge therefore needs this NPS one-day play permit (FAQ: no fee; issued at the Quarry Visitor Center or by the River Office; 2025 guide: also on-site rangers/volunteer camp hosts, no advance reservation).
